title: AWS targets first Saudi Arabia cloud region launch
summary: AWS says its first cloud infrastructure region in Saudi Arabia, representing a $5.3B+ investment with three Availability Zones, is on track to launch in December 2026; no specific day has been confirmed.

sources.title: AWS to launch first cloud infrastructure region in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia by December 2026

title: OpenAI retires gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5 and chatgpt-image-latest
summary: OpenAI removes the gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5 and chatgpt-image-latest models from the API on this date, directing developers to migrate to gpt-image-2; this follows the DALL-E 2/3 retirement in May 2026.

sources.title: OpenAI deprecates three image APIs by December 2026

title: EU AI Act synthetic-content labeling duty takes effect
summary: The EU's Digital Omnibus on AI deferred the Article 50(2) duty requiring AI providers to mark synthetic or deepfake content from August 2, 2026 to December 2, 2026, while other Article 50 transparency duties and GPAI provider obligations kept their original schedule.

sources.title: EU AI Act Omnibus Agreement — Postponed High-Risk Deadlines and Other Key Changes

title: Docker Engine 25.0 branch reaches end of life
summary: The Docker Engine 25.0 release branch reaches its projected end-of-life date, after which it no longer receives patches.

title: NeurIPS 2026
summary: NeurIPS 2026 runs December 6-12 at the International Convention Centre Sydney, Australia, with official satellite tracks in Atlanta and Paris.
location: Sydney, Australia (+ Atlanta and Paris satellites)

title: Microsoft Patch Tuesday - December 2026
summary: Microsoft's monthly scheduled security update release, falling on the second Tuesday of the month per its published cadence.

sources.title: Next Patch Tuesday: Microsoft Update Calendar 2026

title: OpenAI removes legacy GPT-5 and o3 model snapshots from API
summary: OpenAI will remove several dated GPT-5 and o3 snapshots (gpt-5-2025-08-07, gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07, gpt-5-nano-2025-08-07, gpt-5-pro-2025-10-06, o3-2025-04-16, o3-pro-2025-06-10) from the API on December 11, 2026, after announcing the deprecation on June 11, 2026.

title: OpenAI retires older GPT-5 and o3 API snapshots
summary: OpenAI notified developers that older GPT-5 and o3 model snapshots will be removed from the API on December 11, 2026.

title: Cybersecurity Information Sharing Act of 2015 reauthorization deadline
summary: A stopgap federal funding bill passed in early September 2026 extends the Cybersecurity Information Sharing Act of 2015, which gives liability protection to private companies voluntarily sharing cyber threat data with the government, from its September 30 expiration to December 11, 2026.

sources.title: Stopgap funding bill temporarily extends key cyber info-sharing law
CR extends cyber info sharing law through December

title: PHP 8.2 reaches end of life
summary: PHP 8.2 exits its security-only support window and reaches end of life on December 31, 2026, per PHP's own supported-versions schedule; PHP 8.3, 8.4 and 8.5 remain supported.

sources.title: PHP End-of-Life Dates: Support Timeline for Every Version (2026)
